note: The one-button actions of DaVinci Resolve Actions. A new action is a script in this folder and one entry here: id, name, script, args (optional), about, menu (true: also installed into Resolve's Workspace › Scripts › Utility). The app runs it with Resolve's Python from outside (External scripting = Local); its last printed line is shown. Shortcuts are his, set in the window, kept in ~/.config/resolve-actions.json. v8 (28.10.2026): group = the section of the ACTIONS tab; timeout = seconds the router allows it (default 30). v9 (28.10.2026): steps = the step titles of a script that marks its steps with steps.py, so PLAY / NEXT STEP / STOP / RESTART reach it and each step has its status line; an action without steps is one step. v10 (28.10.2026): tab = "MODS" puts it in the MODS tab (changes to how Resolve itself works); without it, ACTIONS. v11 (29.10.2026): ask = questions before every run (folder: the label of a folder field passed as --folder and remembered; checks: tick boxes passed as --their-words; warn: ticks that get a second "are you sure"); direct = true runs with Resolve's Python straight (no router time limit), for long actions.

actions.name: Balancing, Grading, and Exporting Automatic
actions.about: The open timeline: input colour from the Sony XML (S-Log3/S-Gamut3.Cine), every shot balanced to the others (70 %, at most 1.5 stops), the Mantra Filmic look on the group, then each clip rendered alone as MP4 H.264 1920x1080 20 Mb/s into FOR SVEMIR HD H264 beside the footage.

actions.name: Project Backup
actions.about: Backup and clean up of the open project into a folder (an external drive): <folder>/<project>/<project>.drp, Sources/Images, Videos, Audio (every file it uses) and Renders, each copy checked. Delete Source Media: the originals to the Trash afterwards. Delete Source Project: the project deleted from Resolve after its .drp is on the drive, and everything it made on the system drive (renders, render cache, optimized media, gallery stills, captures, proxies) to the Trash.

ask.folder: Backup folder (OK keeps the last one)

steps: Copy the media and the renders
Point the project at the copies
Delete the source project and what it made

actions.name: Create Timeline
actions.about: A new timeline from the clips selected in the Media Pool, named after the first clip, nothing asked.

actions.name: Previous Page
actions.about: Back to the page used before this one; twice and you are back.

actions.name: Toggle HD / UHD
actions.about: The project (and a timeline with its own settings) flips between 1920x1080 and 3840x2160.

actions.name: Check everything
actions.about: Is Resolve up, does its API answer, which project, resolution, page, pages in the bar, scripts installed and current.
